summary: A mission loop with a timeout is re-evaluated when the timeout passes, so it ends on time even when nothing else changes, instead of at the next full pass

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: The loop's timeout verdict is unchanged; only when it is reached changes. A loop waiting on a blocked round or a person used to pass its timeout unnoticed until the reconciler's next full pass.

recovery.detail: An older build ends such a loop at its next full pass.
